summary: Requested execution of a revised experiment that closes the recorded source-only limitation on periodic-heartbeat batching: the same harness now queues two follower reads and lets one ordinary leader tick produce the confirmation heartbeat, with no harness-chosen delivery order. Local construction runs passed and showed the heartbeat carrying the newest context, the reply to the earlier requester carrying that context at the confirmed index, and the earlier batch staying at index zero, while the single-read control completed on the same tick path. Validation reports valid with execution_requested and one experiment create; the resulting interpretation and knowledge update await the retained receipt.
